name: Corporate Governance and CSR
description:
1. Corporate Governance – A Global Perspective.
Meaning and Theories of Corporate Governance (CG).
Global Models of Corporate Governance; Focus on The Asian Experience; Evolution of CG practices in USA, Japan and Germany; Inter-comparison of International models.
Major International Codes & Standards on Corporate Governance – Sir Adrian Cadbury Committee (UK), 1992; OECD Principles of Corporate Governance, 1999; Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act, 2002 (USA); etc.
Whistle-Blowers; Whistle-Blower Policy; Whistle-Blower Legislation across Countries.
Integrated Reporting; Global Reporting Initiatives; ISO 26000; Green Governance/ E-governance.
Analysis of Major Corporate Governance Failures Across the World.
2. Corporate Governance Framework in India.
Evolution of Corporate Governance in India through Indian Case Studies.
Clause 49 of Listing Agreement/LODR.
Corporate Boards and their Powers, Responsibilities, Disqualifications, etc.
Independent Directors.
Audit Independence.
Board Committees and their Functions.
3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).
Meaning; Corporate Philanthropy; CSR and Corporate Sustainability; CSR and Business Ethics.
Environmental Aspect of CSR; CSR Models.
CSR in India - Evolution and Impact.
Amendment to Companies Act, 2013; Implications of Mandatory Clause on CSR.
Lessons from International Experiences - Insights for India.
